title: sec-agent v2.0 Vault Envelope Schema
description: On-disk JSON envelope structure for encrypted v2.0 Dual-Slot profile databases

upgraded_at.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp when vault envelope was created/upgraded

master_key_sha256.description: First 16 hex characters of SHA-256(masterKey) fingerprint

slot1.description: LUKS-style Slot 1 BIP39/Argon2id recovery slot header

argon2_salt.description: Base64-encoded 16-byte random salt used during Argon2id key derivation

wrapped_key.description: Base64-encoded 12-byte nonce prepended to AES-256-GCM encrypted master key ciphertext

payload.description: Base64-encoded 12-byte nonce prepended to AES-256-GCM encrypted EncryptedStore JSON payload
